description: Change of use of an existing dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) to a non-secure children's residential home (Use Class C2)
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate an identified local need for the proposed facility or that it would serve the local community. In addition, no legal agreement has been secured to guarantee priority placements for children within the London Borough of Harrow, meaning the development would not ensure that local childcare needs are met. The proposal therefore represents an inappropriate change of use, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy H12 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies GR1 and HO7 of Harrow Local Plan (2021 - 2041).&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The proposal results in the loss of existing residential floorspace, and no justification or reprovision has been provided to demonstrate that this loss is acceptable. The development would therefore lead to an unwarranted reduction in the borough’s housing stock, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy H8 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy H02 of&nbsp; Harrow Local Plan (2021 – 2041).&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
